component.name: trida-stack
component.description: Components that no dependency scanner can see. Merged into every generated SBOM by .github/workflows/release-sbom.yml.

components.name: HybridDiffusion-block-gated-delta-rule
components.description: Two-stream Gated-DeltaNet + ShortConv Triton kernels. Fetched at build time by train/block_gated_delta_rule/fetch_kernels.sh and patched with trillion_mods.patch. Never committed to this repository.

components.name: HybridDiffusion-sglang-backend
components.description: SGLang serving stack consumed through the HybridDiffusion fork, patched by inference/sglang/two_stream_diffusion.patch (14 files). Upstream sgl-project/sglang is Apache-2.0; the noncommercial restriction is inherited from the HybridDiffusion base.

components.name: HybridDiffusion-block-causal-readout
components.description: block_causal_readout.py, the block-end readout kernel for the vLLM plugin. Assembled by the recipe in inference/vllm/vllm_native_diffusion/KERNELS.md. Never committed.

components.name: instruction_following_eval
components.description: Google Research IFEval scorer, vendored in inference/ifeval_lib/. In-tree source with no package manifest, so dependency scanners do not report it.
